messages:
Maya: CI microbench on PR #12399 failed threshold: batch kernel handoff increased p99 by ~12% on seqlen<=64 workloads. infra-bot posted artifacts.
BuildBot: CI: microbench batch_handoff_perf — FAILED (delta +12%) artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/12399
Liam: Can you paste the bench output? Was this the kernel selector change from #12340?
Maya: Bench snippet:
```
name: batch_handoff_perf
p50: 8.9ms
p95: 15.2ms
p99: 28.7ms (baseline 25.6ms)
delta: +12.1%
commit: 4e5b2c3
```
Serena: Noted drop in kv-cache hitrate in the same run — infra metrics show kv_hit from ~87% -> ~72% for these traces.
Liam: If kv-hit dropped we might be re-routing to a slower kernel because the seqlen histogram changed. Did the sampler weights change in #12340?
Maya: Yes — the sampler flip to "prefetch-balanced" went in with that change. I suspect it produces more short sequences that trigger the handoff heuristic more often.
Zoe: I'll run a local microbench with the old sampler and with commit 4e5b2c3 reverted to isolate. Command: `./run_microbench --bench batch_handoff_perf --repeats 10 --sampler=balanced`
Liam: Also run with `--kv-debug=true` to get per-request hitrates.
BuildBot: Bisect started by @Zoe: trying commits between 3f2a1..4e5b2c3 — I'll post updates.
Zoe: Bisect result: regression introduced by 4e5b2c3 — kernel selector now lowers the handoff threshold for multi-threaded batches, causing more sequences to switch kernels.
Maya: Confirmed locally. Reverting the sampler flip on top of the PR branch brings p99 back down to baseline.
Serena: This lines up with deployment telemetry. We should hold rollout of #12399 and revert the sampler flip in main ASAP.
Zoe: Opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/12410 — tagging @oncall @release
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll add a note to the release ticket and block the merge pipeline until the revert is merged.
Liam: Long-term fix: make the kernel selector robust to sampler-induced seqlen skew. I'll file PERF-1827 to add a regression test that simulates histogram shifts and hardens the heuristic. I'll take it.
Serena: Also adding an alert for >8% p99 delta on microbench CI runs so we catch this class of regressions earlier.
InfraBot: Deployment hold set on PR #12399 by @Zoe
Maya: Thanks all. Postmortem action items: revert, patch selector to consider batch composition, add unit/regression test, and run full perf sweep before next rollout. Scheduling a 15m sync to coordinate.
